free_tier_limits: Basic: 25,000 map views/month; 5,000/month each for static maps, place search, navigation, and elevation; 1 custom style. Limited to non-commercial use on publicly available websites without login.
rate_limits: Default limits per account and IP: Maps 100 requests/second; Static Maps, Elevation, Places, and Routing 1 request/second each.
description: Jawg Maps provides raster and vector maps, geocoding and reverse geocoding, routing, static maps, place search, and elevation using access-token authentication. Its free Basic plan is restricted to non-commercial use on publicly available websites without login.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Corrected; the current Basic-plan quotas and non-commercial restriction are published at https://www.jawg.io/en/pricing/. rate_limits: Corrected; current per-account-and-IP defaults are published at https://www.jawg.io/docs/apidocs/. description: Corrected because the pricing page restricts Basic to non-commercial, public, no-login websites; the service list is confirmed by https://www.jawg.io/docs/.
